_comment: One entry per maker or partner. `where`: 'boutique' (sold in the lavender boutique now), 'festival' (Lavender Festival market; add `festivalDays`), 'collaborator' (works with the farm: events, weddings, grain, a cider). `placeholder: true` shows a 'Placeholder' chip and keeps the page out of the sitemap; use it for entries not yet approved. `productIds` are Square item ids of their pieces in the shop. `featured` picks the homepage spotlight. `portrait` is an image the farm owns (its own photos or Square product photos); until a maker sends a real portrait it shows their work or a place connected to them, described by `portraitAlt`. Never use photos copied from a maker's own site or social accounts without their permission.

makers.name: Gail Harper
makers.craftDetail: Landscape watercolors, plus pottery ring dishes and lavender hangers in the boutique
makers.bio: Gail has always been drawn to art, but she didn’t take it seriously until later in life. After a move and a career change she taught herself to draw, then started watercolor classes at a local studio. Retirement brought her back to it for good, and she has been painting ever since. Landscapes are her favorite subject, especially the way watercolor catches light and weather. One year she challenged herself to paint a hundred small four-by-four-inch pieces, and that practice still shows in her work. She is also Ginger’s sister, and her handmade ring dishes and lavender hangers have a permanent spot on the boutique shelves.
makers.portraitAlt: Gail Harper in an Olympic Bluffs Cidery hoodie at a glacier lagoon in Iceland

makers.name: Rebelution Yoga + Wellness
makers.craftDetail: Yoga + Cider mornings in the lavender fields
makers.bio: A Port Angeles studio offering yoga, meditation, breathwork and retreats that are trauma-informed and LGBTQIA2S+ affirming. They lead our Yoga + Cider mornings: a flow in the fields, then a glass of cider.
makers.portraitAlt: A yoga mat, a bundle of lavender and a glass of cider beside the lavender fields

makers.name: The Goat & The Radish
makers.craftDetail: Farm-to-table catering for weddings at Salt & Cedar
makers.bio: A family-run café and co-op market on Highway 101 between Sequim and Port Angeles, known for crepes, seasonal specials and charcuterie boxes to go. They cater weddings and events at Salt & Cedar Bed and Breakfast.
makers.portraitAlt: A Goat & The Radish charcuterie board with their catering menu

makers.name: Jean Lenke Music
makers.craftDetail: Jazz-folk music for ceremonies and dinners
makers.bio: Jean Lenke is a crossover jazz-folk vocalist and bandleader who moved to the Olympic Peninsula after years performing in Philadelphia. She plays weddings and events at Salt & Cedar, from ceremony music to a full evening set.

makers.name: WSU Breadlab
makers.craftDetail: Heritage wheat and rye for our acre of ancient grains
makers.bio: Washington State University’s Breadlab breeds and studies grains for flavor, nutrition and regional farming. We grow an acre of their heritage wheat and rye and mill it into flour on the farm.
makers.portraitAlt: Wheat and a seeded loaf from the WSU Breadlab
